settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account settings and Nostr identity

nostr.title: Nostr Identity
nostr.description: Your decentralized identity on the Nostr network. Keep your private key secure!

publicKey.description: This is your public identity on Nostr. Safe to share publicly.

privateKey.warning: ⚠️ Keep this private! Never share your private key with anyone.
privateKey.alby: ℹ️ Your private key is securely managed by the Alby extension and cannot be accessed directly.
privateKey.managed: Private key managed by Alby extension

security.title: Security Reminder
security.description: Your private key (nsec) gives full control over your Nostr identity. Store it safely and never share it with anyone.

recovery.title: Account Recovery
recovery.description: Set up email and password recovery to secure your account. This allows you to recover your account if you lose access to your primary login method.
recovery.success: Account recovery has been set up successfully!

notice.title: Important:
notice.description: Your recovery email and password will be used to restore access to your account if you lose your primary authentication method. Keep them secure and accessible.

actions.title: Account Actions
actions.description: Manage your account settings and authentication.

passkey.title: Passkey Sync
passkey.description: Set up a WebAuthn passkey to sync your biometric authentication across devices and browsers.
passkey.success: Passkey has been set up successfully!

error.setup: Failed to setup passkey. Please try again.

notice.title: About Passkeys:
notice.description: Passkeys allow you to authenticate using the same biometric data across different browsers and devices. Once set up, you can use this passkey to log in from other devices.

test.error: Passkey test failed. Please try again.
